title: USDC Checkout
description: A storefront's onchain register: the owner lists products priced in USDC, buyers pay with approve or a one-transaction permit, and every order is recorded so the store can fulfil, refund, and withdraw.
prompts: Accept USDC payments in my online store
Build a checkout where customers pay for products in USDC
I sell digital goods and want onchain payments with refunds

params.name: owner
params.description: Store owner: manages products, refunds, and withdrawals

params.name: productPrice
params.description: Price of the first product in USDC base units (6 decimals). The default is 5 USDC.

prerequisites: Native gas on the C-Chain for the signer
USDC for test purchases, from the Circle faucet listed in the registry

contracts.name: USDCCheckout
contracts.description: Product catalog, orders, refunds, and withdrawals

contracts.name: ERC20
contracts.description: Standard ERC-20 ABI, used for USDC approvals and balance reads

steps.title: Transfer the store to its owner
Approve USDC for a test purchase
Buy one unit of the first product

checks.description: The first product costs the configured price
The store belongs to its owner
The test payment is held by the checkout

review: The payment token is USDC from $net.main.tokens.USDC.address; prices are in 6-decimal base units.
Buyers approve exactly priceOf(productId, quantity), or sign a permit for that amount.
The owner keeps enough balance for the refund window before withdrawing; refunds come out of the contract's balance.
Fulfilment keys off the OrderPaid event and the recorded amount, never off a client-side claim.

frontend.summary: A storefront where customers pay in USDC in one or two clicks and get a receipt.
audience: The shop owner, who manages orders and refunds
journeys: Browse products with names, images and prices in USDC; unavailable ones show 'Sold out'.
Pay: a quantity stepper, the total, and 'Pay 24.00 USDC'; one signature with permit, or two visible steps when the wallet can't sign permits.
A receipt: order number, what was bought, amount, and a transaction link.
My orders: the customer's past orders and refunds.
Shop owner area, shown only to the owner: orders, refunds, withdraw to the treasury, pause.
flows: Read products with getProduct(id) and show prices with 6 decimals.
Checkout with permit: sign EIP-2612 typed data for priceOf(id, qty) on the USDC contract, then call purchaseWithPermit. Fall back to approve plus purchase for wallets that cannot sign typed data.
Pass the store's cart or session id as orderRef (bytes32), then match OrderPaid(orderId, buyer, productId, quantity, amount, orderRef) in the backend to fulfil.
Owner dashboard: list orders from OrderPaid and OrderRefunded events, refund by orderId, withdraw to a treasury address, pause in an emergency.
